title: Tangkhul Tui Dictionary
creator: N. Luikham
notes: Comprehensive modern Tangkhul dictionary published by TLS. Discoverable via Bharatavani Bhashakosha. Metadata-only cataloguing; full text restricted under publisher copyright.
background: Compiled by prominent educator and linguist N. Luikham and published by the Tangkhul Literature Society (TLS) in Ukhrul in 1997, this dictionary is the standard contemporary lexical authority for the Tangkhul community. It documents tens of thousands of contemporary, ceremonial, customary, and cultural vocabulary words that developed during the 20th century. Discoverable through the Government of India's Bharatavani Bhashakosha portal.
phonology_notes: Standardizes contemporary Tangkhul spelling as endorsed by the Tangkhul Literature Society. Preserves indigenous compound words, ceremonial terms from traditional festivals, and customary institutions.
